Fix `packages/element/src/pages.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Security review (Gate 3 approved fixes), see security_review.md. (1) MEDIUM: restorePages accepts any string as a page `index` and later passes it to generateKeyBetween (previousIndex / lastVisible.index, also in createPage and movePage), which throws `invalid order key` on a bad key; a collaborator or crafted file can then break page create/move for every peer and leave a Firebase room that never loads. Fix: in restorePages validate raw.index with validateOrderKey from @excalidraw/fractional-indexing inside try/catch (or an equivalent isValidIndex check); when invalid or missing, generate a fresh key with generateKeyBetween(lastValidKey, null) from the last VALID key, so every index that leaves restorePages is valid and ascending. (2) LOW: cap page name length (100 characters, truncate), cap the page count (e.g. MAX_PAGES = 500, keep the first ones), require `version` and `versionNonce` to be finite safe integers (Number.isSafeInteger, else 1 / 0), and skip page ids `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype`. Export the caps as constants. Keep all existing behaviour and exports.

Fix `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:typecheck:
excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx(903,7): error TS2322: Type 'Pick<AppState, "pages"> & Partial<Pick<AppState, "zoom" | "scrollX" | "scrollY" | "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "editingGroupId" | "activePageId" | "pageViewports">>' is not assignable to type 'Pick<AppState, "zoom" | "scrollX" | ... | "pageViewports"> | null | undefined'. Types of property 'zoom' are incompatible: 'Readonly<{ value: NormalizedZoomValue; }> | undefined' is not assignable.
updateScene infers its generic K from the object, so a Partial makes every key required-but-possibly-undefined. Fix in handleRemotePagesUpdate: call updateScene in two branches — when switchState is null, `updateScene({ appState: { pages }, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER })`; when switching, `updateScene({ appState: { pages, activePageId: switchState.activePageId, scrollX: switchState.scrollX, scrollY: switchState.scrollY, zoom: switchState.zoom, pageViewports: switchState.pageViewports, selectedElementIds: switchState.selectedElementIds, selectedGroupIds: switchState.selectedGroupIds, editingGroupId: switchState.editingGroupId }, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER })` — no Partial type, no spread of a full AppState. Keep the early return when pages did not change.
